algorithm_navigation_checks.json.scope: Local HTTP combined website navigation and download identity

nuscenes.label_source: Source candidate types and annotation-backed occupancy; no independent structure-versus-state labels
limitations: Source occupancy uses annotation-backed footprints, not rerun camera detection.
Semantic routing is not proof that the candidate change is real.
Old temporary/permanent labels are not structure/state ground truth.
No scene identity or event lifetime is used to choose a map layer.

argoverse.prediction_unit: one exact physical boundary; aliases never expand into multiple true positives
argoverse.exact_object_scope_note: Coarse any-change object diagnostic on single-reference predictions only, not boundary/type accuracy. Multi-alias output is excluded; main geometry metrics above check the actual claimed boundary.

task_support_breakdown.note: Reference records can share physical geometry. NONE is unpainted or logical lane geometry, not a missing painted-line measurement; additions and semantic/topology changes require different observations.

layer_on_true_geometry_hits.label_source: Supplied prior/current lane geometry; no lifetime assumption.

limitations: Constructed-train development scene; parameters not fitted to these labels.
Whole supplied geometry scope includes unobserved areas; not visibility-conditioned accuracy.
Geometry-only scope excludes additions, topology, lane-use, color and unknown paint references.
Correct layer identity does not cancel a wrong boundary, side, geometry or operation.

scope: Frozen perception inputs; new reliability, structure/state routing and event lifecycle. Local Chromium/SwiftShader checks; live GitHub Pages delivery not verified.
